item.title: Ringtown Man Charged After Alleged Assault Involving Pistol and Hot Soup
item.description: A Ringtown man is facing multiple charges after Pennsylvania State Police say he assaulted his wife during a violent altercation in Shenandoah on December 5, 2025.Aaron P. Lorah, 37, of Ringtown, was arraigned Friday night before Magisterial District Judge Anthony J. Kilker on charges of simple assault (M2), terroristic threats with intent to terrorize another (M1), and harassment (S). item.title: GIRLS BASKETBALL: Lourdes Regional Rolls Past Tri-Valley to Stay Unbeaten
item.description: Lourdes Regional continued its dominant early-season run on Tuesday night, powering past Tri-Valley, 52–16, in a Schuylkill League Division 2 matchup. The Red Raiders came out firing, overwhelming Tri-Valley with a 26–3 first-quarter advantage and never letting up. By halftime, Lourdes held a commanding 39–6 lead.
